_about: Checked key + chord answers for the Improv Practice song box (mp3-downloads.html). Songs listed here are answered from this file before the AI is asked. 'aliases' are other ways students type the title. 'key' must read like '<tonic> <major|minor>' so the scale chart can switch to it.

songs.title: 7 Summers
songs.progression: Verse Cmaj7 – Fmaj7 | Chorus Dm7 – G – Cmaj7 – Am7
songs.numerals: Imaj7 – IVmaj7 | ii7 – V – Imaj7 – vi7
songs.scale: C major (C major pentatonic for a country feel)
songs.tip: The intro riff is the Cmaj7 and Fmaj7 shapes slid up the G and D strings; leave space between phrases.

songs.title: Let It Be
songs.progression: C – G – Am – F | C – G – F – C
songs.numerals: I – V – vi – IV | I – V – IV – I
songs.tip: Land phrases on the chord tones of Am and F; the melody sits mostly in the C major pentatonic.

songs.title: Three Little Birds
songs.tip: Keep the off-beat reggae skank steady and keep fills short.

songs.title: Wonderwall
songs.progression: Em7 – G – Dsus4 – A7sus4 (shapes with capo 2) | Chorus Cadd9 – Dsus4 – Em7
songs.scale: F# minor pentatonic (A major pentatonic sounds the same)
songs.tip: Keep your ring and pinky fingers planted on the B and high E strings for every chord.

songs.title: Hotel California
songs.progression: Bm – F#7 – A – E – G – D – Em – F#7
songs.numerals: i – V7 – VII – IV – VI – III – iv – V7
songs.scale: B harmonic minor over F#7, B minor pentatonic elsewhere
songs.tip: Switch to B harmonic minor (A# instead of A) whenever F#7 comes around.

songs.title: Knockin' on Heaven's Door
songs.progression: G – D – Am | G – D – C
songs.numerals: I – V – ii | I – V – IV
songs.tip: Only four chords, so it is a great song for practising slow, melodic bends.

songs.title: Stand By Me
songs.tip: Copy the famous bass line on the low strings before you solo over it.

songs.title: Sweet Home Alabama
songs.scale: D mixolydian (D major with a C natural)
songs.tip: The C chord means D mixolydian, not plain D major; try D major pentatonic plus C.

songs.title: Brown Eyed Girl
songs.progression: G – C – G – D | Chorus C – D – G – Em – C – D
songs.numerals: I – IV – I – V | IV – V – I – vi – IV – V
songs.tip: Play the intro riff in thirds on the G and B strings.

songs.title: A Horse with No Name
songs.tip: Two chords the whole song; the C# in E dorian gives it that open, dusty sound.

songs.title: Riptide
songs.progression: Am – G – C | Am – G – F
songs.numerals: vi – V – I | vi – V – IV
songs.tip: Originally on ukulele; keep the strum light and bouncy.

songs.title: Hallelujah
songs.progression: C – Am – C – Am – F – G – C – G | Chorus F – Am – F – C – G – C
songs.numerals: I – vi – I – vi – IV – V – I – V
songs.tip: It is in 12/8, so count it in slow groups of three.

songs.title: Take Me Home, Country Roads
songs.progression: Verse A – F#m – E – D | Chorus A – E – F#m – D
songs.numerals: I – vi – V – IV | I – V – vi – IV
songs.tip: Big open chords; fill the gaps with hammer-ons from the A major pentatonic.

songs.title: Wagon Wheel
songs.tip: Same four chords the whole song, so practise switching between rhythm and short fills.

songs.title: No Woman, No Cry
songs.tip: Classic I–V–vi–IV; listen for the descending bass line C – B – A – F.

songs.title: Stairway to Heaven
songs.progression: Am – Am/G# – C/G – D/F# – Fmaj7 – G – Am
songs.numerals: i – (chromatic bass) – III – IV – VI – VII – i
songs.scale: A minor pentatonic for the solo, A dorian for the intro
songs.tip: The intro is a descending bass line under a fixed top note; play it slowly and evenly.

songs.title: Wish You Were Here
songs.progression: C – D/F# – Am – G – D/F# – C – Am – G
songs.numerals: IV – V – ii – I – V – IV – ii – I
songs.scale: G major pentatonic (E minor pentatonic for the intro lick)
songs.tip: The intro lick is E minor pentatonic over Em7 and G.

songs.title: Jolene
songs.progression: Am – C – G – Am (shapes with capo 4)
songs.scale: C# minor pentatonic (A minor pentatonic shapes with the capo)
songs.tip: Keep a steady fingerpicking pattern; the chords barely change.

songs.title: Candy Cane Children
songs.progression: D5 – C5 – G5 – A5 (power chords; roughly Dm – C – G – A)
songs.scale: D natural minor (D minor pentatonic or D blues for a garage-rock sound)
songs.tip: The power chords have no 3rds, so it can sound minor or major; D minor pentatonic fits all four.
